import warnings
from boltons.funcutils import FunctionBuilder, inspect_formatargspec, formatargandannotation
from boltons.setutils import IndexedSet, complement
from boltons.dictutils import OneToOne, FastIterOrderedMultiDict
from boltons.iterutils import unique
from glom import *

def f(a: int=1, *args: str, b: int=2, **kw: float) -> bool:
    return True
with warnings.catch_warnings():
    warnings.simplefilter('error', DeprecationWarning)
    fb=FunctionBuilder.from_func(f)
    assert fb.get_defaults_dict() == {'a':1, 'b':2}
    print(fb.get_sig_str())
    assert fb.get_func()() is None
assert set([1,2,3]) - IndexedSet([2]) == IndexedSet([1,3])
a=IndexedSet([1,2,3,4]);a.difference_update([1],[3]);assert a == IndexedSet([2,4])
assert set([1,2,3]) - complement({2}) == {2}
assert set([1,2,3]) - complement(complement({2})) == {1,3}
a=OneToOne([('a',1), ('b',1)]);del a['a'];assert a.inv == {1:'b'};del a['b'];assert not a.inv
a=OneToOne([('a',1), ('b',1)]);del a['b'];assert a.inv == {1:'a'}
print(glom({'a':3}, Fill({'literal': T['a'], T['a']: Auto('a')})))
assert glom({'a':3}, (Let(x='a'), S.x)) == 3
assert glom([0,1,2,3,4], Iter().filter(lambda x:x%2).chunked(2).all()) == [[1,3]]
assert glom([0,1,2,3], Iter().dropwhile(lambda x:x<2).all()) == [2,3]
assert glom([[1,2],[3]], Iter().flatten().all()) == [1,2,3]
assert glom([0,1,2], Iter().first()) == 1
assert glom({'a':1}, Inspect({'x':'a'}, recursive=True, echo=False)) == {'x':1}
print('API smoke checks passed')
